verdicts.feedback: Part (c) is too vague to earn the point. "The government responded by doing things to help" names no specific federal action, and "enforced desegregation" does not give a concrete example such as the 1957 Little Rock Nine deployment. A one-point SAQ response needs a specific government action tied to a concrete example.

priorityFix: Specificity on part (c): name one exact federal action and one detail. Instead of "the government enforced desegregation," write something like "the federal government sent troops to Little Rock in 1957 to protect Black students integrating Central High School." One named action plus one concrete detail earns the point.
sampleResponseComparison: Your parts (a) and (b) already carry the specificity the sample response has, which is why both earned the point. Part (c) is where you fell short: the sample names the exact action (sending troops), the case (Little Rock), and what it enforced. Your answer kept the action abstract, so the grader could not verify that you know a real federal response.
